description: Black-and-white photograph of six people standing on a lawn in front of a stone-and-stucco house with large windows. The man at center, in a grey Zhongshan (Mao) suit, is Mao Zedong; he is flanked by three other Chinese men in dark Mao suits and by an elderly Western woman in a fur-trimmed coat and an elderly Western man in a dark suit with arms crossed, both smiling. The setting and dress suggest a mid-20th-century meeting between Mao and Western visitors; the other individuals are not identified in the image.
flags: Only Mao Zedong identified with confidence; the Western visitors and other Chinese officials are not named in the image and are left unidentified

description: Color news photograph of George Soros (left, smiling, wearing a dark coat and grey scarf) speaking with Sen. John McCain (right, in profile in the foreground, dark suit and tie) in front of a cream curtain. The original filename indicates the photo was taken at the World Economic Forum in Davos, Switzerland.
flags: Davos/WEF location comes from the filename, not from anything visible in the image

description: Stock-style image of a yellow diamond road sign reading STORM COMING with a rectangular WARNING plaque below it, set against dark, ominous storm clouds. Used in Q-related posting as imagery for "the storm".

Meme built from a video still of Sen. Chuck Schumer looking downcast, wearing glasses low on his nose, with the caption "I’M SCARED" in white block letters across the top. The caption is the meme-maker’s mocking attribution, not a Schumer quote.
flags: Caption is satirical text added by the meme creator, not an actual statement by Schumer

description: Screenshot of a tweet presenting a purported 2016 email from a "Todd Macklerr" to Donna Brazile and John Podesta, subject "The Dogs Are Loose", with lines highlighted in yellow claiming an upcoming meeting with Soros for "pre-programming" of voting machines and that "these machines will be humming in November". The tweet caption asserts this proves a plot to pre-program voting machines; the email's authenticity is not established and it circulated as an unverified/likely fabricated document. Tweet shows 3 replies, 28 retweets, 19 likes.
text: Todd Macklerr telling Donna Brazille & John Podesta and he will be meeting with SOROS to PRE-PROGRAM voting machines! #Prison. From: Todd Macklerr <toddemail@macklerr.com>. To: donna@brazileassociates.com; john.podesta@gmail.com. Date: 2016-03-19 15:43. Subject: The Dogs Are Loose. Hey guys, as you can see from the subject - The Dogs Are Loose. I repeat - The Dogs Are Loose. Loose dogs, guys. You know what to do from here. I'll be meeting with Soros later this week for some "pre-programming" of machines. We're also going to check out a Collective Soul concert. Never knew George was a fan, but he is and so am I, so we're going. That isn't code or anything so don't bother looking for the corresponding code - this just means we're actually going to see Collective Soul in concert. More to come. But yeah, these machines will be humming in November, just like I'll be humming a few Collective Soul songs next week.. 3. 28. 19.
flags: Unverified claim: the 'Todd Macklerr' email is presented as genuine but is unauthenticated and widely regarded as fabricated/satirical; the archive records the claim without endorsing it
'Todd Macklerr' is not an identified real public figure and is listed nowhere; names appear only as written in the document
